name: Right-to-Know Request Templates
description: Pre-built templates for common RTK requests

baseTemplate.header:
RIGHT-TO-KNOW LAW REQUEST
Pursuant to 65 P.S. § 67.101 et seq.
baseTemplate.opening:
Dear Open Records Officer:

Pursuant to the Pennsylvania Right-to-Know Law, 65 P.S. § 67.101 et seq., I am requesting access to and copies of the following public records:
baseTemplate.formatRequest: I am requesting these records in {format}.
baseTemplate.responseReminder: As provided by the Right-to-Know Law, I expect a response within five (5) business days. If you expect a delay in responding to this request, please notify me in writing stating the reasons for the delay.
baseTemplate.denialReminder: If my request is denied in whole or in part, please cite the specific exemption(s) under the Right-to-Know Law that justify the denial, and notify me of the appeal procedures available to me under the Law.
baseTemplate.closing:
Thank you for your assistance with this request.

Sincerely,

templates.name: Government Contracts
templates.recordsText:
All contracts, agreements, and purchase orders exceeding $[AMOUNT] awarded by [DEPARTMENT/AGENCY] between [START DATE] and [END DATE], including:
- Vendor/contractor names
- Contract amounts
- Services or goods provided
- Contract start and end dates
- Any amendments or renewals
tips: Specify a dollar threshold to narrow results
Include date range to limit scope
Request any amendments/renewals separately if needed

templates.name: Employee Salaries
templates.recordsText:
A list of all [DEPARTMENT] employees showing:
- Name
- Job title
- Annual salary or hourly rate
- Date of hire
- Overtime paid (if applicable)

For the period [START DATE] to [END DATE].
tips: Public employee salaries are public record in PA
You can request by department or county-wide
Overtime data may reveal staffing issues

templates.name: Email Communications
templates.description: Request email correspondence on specific topics
templates.recordsText:
All emails sent or received by [OFFICIAL/DEPARTMENT] containing the following keywords or regarding the following subject matter:

[KEYWORDS/SUBJECT]

For the period [START DATE] to [END DATE].

Please include any attachments to these emails.
tips: Be specific about keywords and date range
Emails discussing government business are generally public
Personal emails on government devices may also be public

templates.name: Meeting Materials
templates.description: Request agendas, minutes, and supporting documents
templates.recordsText:
All materials related to the [COUNCIL/BOARD/COMMITTEE] meeting held on [DATE], including:
- Agenda
- Minutes (if approved)
- Supporting documents for each agenda item
- Presentations
- Public comment sign-in sheets
- Any recordings
tips: Minutes may not be available until approved at next meeting
Executive session minutes are generally exempt
Request video recordings if meetings are taped

templates.name: Budget Documents
templates.description: Request budget details and spending reports
templates.recordsText:
The following budget documents for fiscal year [YEAR]:
- Adopted budget by department
- Line-item expenditure reports (year-to-date)
- Budget amendments
- Fund balance reports
- [SPECIFIC DEPARTMENT] detailed budget breakdown
tips: County budgets are public
Request quarterly or monthly expenditure reports
Compare adopted vs. actual spending

templates.name: Policies and Procedures
templates.description: Request official policies on specific topics
templates.recordsText:
All current policies, procedures, guidelines, and training materials regarding [TOPIC], including:
- Written policies
- Standard operating procedures
- Employee handbooks/manuals related to this topic
- Any recent updates or revisions
tips: Good for understanding how decisions are made
Compare actual practice to written policy
Request revision history to see changes over time

templates.name: Vendor Payments
templates.description: Request payments to specific vendor or all vendors
templates.recordsText:
All payments made to [VENDOR NAME / all vendors] by [DEPARTMENT / the county] between [START DATE] and [END DATE], including:
- Payment date
- Payment amount
- Invoice number or description
- Department charged
tips: Track spending patterns with specific vendors
Can reveal no-bid or sole-source purchasing
Compare to contract amounts

templates.name: Complaints/Grievances
templates.recordsText:
All complaints, grievances, or formal concerns filed regarding [DEPARTMENT/FACILITY/ISSUE] between [START DATE] and [END DATE], including:
- Date of complaint
- Nature of complaint (redacted as necessary to protect privacy)
- Resolution or current status
- Any corrective actions taken

I understand that personal identifying information may be redacted.
tips: Useful for tracking patterns of problems
Request aggregate data if individual records denied
Follow up on resolution status

templates.name: Inspections/Audits
templates.description: Request inspection reports and audit findings
templates.recordsText:
All inspection reports, audit findings, and compliance reviews for [FACILITY/DEPARTMENT/PROGRAM] conducted between [START DATE] and [END DATE], including:
- Inspection/audit reports
- Findings and citations
- Corrective action plans
- Follow-up inspection results
tips: State inspections of county facilities are public
Request both internal and external audits
Ask for corrective action status

templates.name: 911 Call Data
templates.description: Request 911 call statistics or specific incident data
templates.recordsText:
911 call data for [MUNICIPALITY/AREA] between [START DATE] and [END DATE], including:
- Call type/nature
- Response times
- Dispatched units
- Location (block level acceptable if exact address restricted)

[OR for specific incident:]
All 911 call records and CAD data for the incident at [LOCATION] on [DATE/TIME].
tips: Response time data reveals service levels
May not get exact addresses for some call types
Audio recordings may require separate request

process: File written appeal within 15 business days
Include copy of original request and denial
OOR will issue decision within 30 days
